[RTCT.6.7.1] A `RealtimeContract` carries its per-node capacities
in **exactly one** of two encodings:

  - **legacy** — `nodes` (8) non-empty; fields 11–14 unset/zero.
  - **compact** — `nodes` (8) empty; `node_count` (11) set;
    capacities given by `default_node_cap` (12) +
    `node_overrides` (13), **or** by `node_caps_packed` (14).

A body with both `nodes` (8) non-empty and any of fields 11–14
set is `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`.
